steps.text: Assalamu alaikum, my student. Today we meet a new friend of the alphabet: Alif (ا). A deep open 'a' — the spine of the alphabet. Take your time — every letter of the Qur'an is a door, and doors open slowly and surely.

steps.note: You will see ا in words like آدَم (Aadam), which means Adam, the first human and prophet.

steps.text: Look at the shape until your eyes know it. Say its name three times, slowly. The Prophet ﷺ loved that the Qur'an be learned gently — he was sent, he said, as a teacher made easy with his people.

steps.question: Which letter did we meet today?
steps.why: Today was Alif — ا. Review the card above and it will settle, in shaa Allah.

steps.text: Well walked. One letter a day, and the alphabet becomes a garden you planted yourself. See you at the next lesson — Wasia is proud of you.
